messages:
jamie: Hey team — Valora Systems signed the trial agreement this morning. Sales asks: can we confirm the minimal integration deliverables + a soft cutoff for the 4-week POC? Need a checklist to share with the customer by EOD.

sophia: Thanks. Quick context: Valora wants document ingestion + chat over private data, and embeddings for semantic search. Success criteria they gave: <80ms median query latency, 95% of queries return relevant doc within top3, and no PII leakage during staging. Is that still feasible in 4 weeks?

alex: Feasible if we scope carefully. Proposed minimal deliverables:
- ingestion pipeline (S3->Redwood connector) + sample mapping
- embeddings index + re-ranking route
- chat endpoint with model pinned to rdx-1-small (or fallback rdx-1-medium)
- 1 canary-only deploy in staging, 1 production cutover

Owners: alex (ingest + embeddings infra), marcus (chat integration + auth), sophia (customer comms / acceptance tests). Timeline: week 1 ingestion + creds, week 2 embeddings + index tuning, week 3 chat integration + perf tuning, week 4 canary + acceptance + handover.

marcus: I'll open the PRs today. CR checklist:
- tests for prefix caching behavior
- example prompt set for relevancy evals
- smoke test runbook (how to revert canary)
PRs: https://git.company/rdx/valora-integ/pulls (I'll post numbers when created).

sophia: For staging creds — do we want to give them short-lived tokens or a restricted service account? Preference from security?

alex: Use restricted service account with role limited to the S3 ingest bucket + read-only to embeddings index. We'll provision ephemeral tokens for their engineers to run ad-hoc tests via `rdx auth issue --ttl 8h` (ops will audit).

eng-oncall-bot: Scheduled: dry-run deploy to staging cluster 'staging-valora' at 2026-04-06T16:00Z. Notified: @alex @marcus.

marcus: Noted. I'll run the smoke test after the deploy and post results in this thread. If perf is off, first action is to enable KV cache for chat route and increase batching window to 60ms.

jamie: Can we get an ETA for the checklist doc? I'll send it to Valora PM at 17:00 PT. Also need the contact for the infra admin who will accept the onboarding invite.

sophia: I'll draft the checklist and acceptance criteria doc, include tasks and owners from alex/marcus, and ping you for review by 16:30 PT. Infra admin: @alex.

alex: I'll accept onboarding invite and add marcus as co-admin. Also will tag @eng-oncall for capacity headroom check.

marcus: PR #12 opened: adds chat webhook + smoke tests. Tagging reviewers @alex @sophia. ETA for reviews: 6-8h.

sophia: Perfect. Jamie — once you send the checklist we can attach the acceptance test matrix (small sample queries + expected top3 docs) so Valora can run them locally before canary.

jamie: Great — sending now. One last ask from customer: can we promise a 2-hour response window for Sev-1 during the canary? They want a dedicated Slack contact.

alex: We can do 2-hour during canary. I'll stand by for the canary window and will put my on-call rotation in the doc.

jamie: Awesome, thanks all. I'll update the customer and close the loop after you post PR results. :thumbsup:
